newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat after brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat after brisk trade.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,605-1,608 per dollar, unchanged from the morning's 1,605-1,609 but a touch softer from 1,602-1,607 at the previous close after a brisk interbank trade, dealers said.

"Both dollar demand and supply rose today, which resulted in a more active trade. But the exchange rate was stable on opening levels throughout the day as supply and demand were balanced," one dealer said.
The lev dip from Wednesday's close was due solely to the longer value date of today's spot deals, which falls on Monday, dealers said.
The current large spread between interest rates on lev- and dollar-denominated deposits allows for a daily lev fall by around 10 per dollar at current exchange rate levels, dealers said.
The central bank main interest rate is now set at 18 percent monthly or 216 percent annually. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
